abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Sanitized bundle contains target1.pdb, target2.pdb, target3.pdb and source_manifest.json only. Parsed target files show no HEADER metadata and no HETATM ligand records, so target identity was inferred by polymer sequence search plus compact coordinate/atom-count matching against public RCSB entries. target1 is a 151-residue MCL-1 chain J fragment, exact-sequence hits include 4HW2/4HW3/4ZBF/4ZBI; coordinate/chain match is closest to public 4ZBF chain J (RMSD-like same-order comparison about 0.5 A). Known MCL-1 ligands in this family include 19H/19G/4M7/4M6/5X2, all acidic hydrophobic BH3-groove binders. target2 is a 257-residue TYK2 JH2 pseudokinase/allosteric inhibitor family member, exact-sequence hits include 3ZON/4OLI/4WOV/5C01/5C03/5TKD/6NSL/6NZE; relevant public ligand codes include IK1, 2TT, 3SM, 7GL, KZJ, L8Y, and 9ZS. target3 is a 292-residue GPR119 GPCR chain R, closest to public 7XZ5 chain R (RMSD-like same-order comparison about 0.32 A), with public agonist/lipid context ligands LSC, I7J, 8VP, 8WL, DR7 across related hits.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: No raw PDB coordinates or sequences were recorded. Local artifacts with compact metadata only: file:experiments/public_pdbs/match_summary.json and file:experiments/public_pdbs/chemcomp_ligands.json. Public reference URLs: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/4ZBF, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/6NZE, https://www.rcsb.org/structure/7XZ5, plus RCSB chemcomp endpoints for ligand codes. Pocket implications: target1 wants an anionic anchor plus extended hydrophobic/aromatic substituents; target2 wants ATP/allosteric hinge-adjacent H-bond donors/acceptors with moderate polarity; target3 wants lipophilic GPCR agonist features but very long lipids like LSC are evaluator-route risky. Baseline-like generic scaffolds would likely fail by missing these target-specific pharmacophores or by whole-protein-box docking noise because sanitized structures lack HETATM pocket anchors.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Built five independent one-row-per-target candidate zips from public ligand families matched to the inferred targets. All screened rows passed RDKit route validity, descriptor risk checks, and OpenBabel ligand prep at offline_eval tier 1. Tier 2 docking against sanitized target PDBs favored the set with target1=19H-class MCL-1 indole carboxylic acid, target2=KZJ-class TYK2 JH2 allosteric inhibitor, target3=8VP-class GPR119 agonist. This set had tier-2 official-weighted proxy mean 87.5549 and minimum 87.1836, with Vina affinities target1 -9.639, target2 -9.636, target3 -9.793 kcal/mol. Other sets were rejected: 4M7/L8Y/I7J had stronger target1 docking but worse mean/min proxy; small target2 9ZS improved descriptor proxy but weakened target2 binding; native lipid LSC and DR7 were rejected before packaging due rotor/MW/TPSA route risk.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Evidence files: file:experiments/candidate_screen/build_candidates.py, file:experiments/candidate_screen/eval_t1/*/summary.json, file:experiments/candidate_screen/eval_t2/*/per_molecule.csv. Design rationale per target: target1 keeps acidic MCL-1 BH3-groove anchor and hydrophobic chlorodimethyl-phenoxy indole scaffold; target2 keeps imidazopyridazine/pyridone-cyclopropylamide H-bonding and allosteric JH2 pocket pharmacophore from KZJ/6NSL-class chemistry; target3 uses the 8VP/MBX-like GPR119 agonist family instead of the long-chain LPC ligand to avoid rotors and route penalties while retaining GPCR agonist heteroaryl-piperidine features.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Wrote exactly one final candidate archive to /work/targetmol/run/agent/candidate/result.zip. validate_cli accepted the archive with rows result1.csv=1, result2.csv=1, result3.csv=1, log_bytes=378, size=945, sha256=a00495035a8365e4cead32102da8011557959fddae93821bfd0859c966ae0b16. A separate zipfile/CSV/RDKit check confirmed member order [result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log], one row per target, final product string equal to mol_smiles for each route, and RDKit canonical equality true for all three rows. offline_eval tier 2 on the absolute final archive completed with failure_count=0, ok_count=3/3, official_weighted_proxy_score_mean=85.9621, official_weighted_proxy_score_min=82.9023, proxy_score_mean=77.7459, proxy_score_min=75.9401.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Final target rows: target1 19H-class MCL-1 indole carboxylic acid; target2 KZJ-class TYK2 JH2 allosteric inhibitor; target3 8VP-class GPR119 agonist. Final tier-2 per-target affinities were target1 -5.526, target2 -9.604, target3 -9.956 kcal/mol; the target1 value was lower than the earlier screening rerun for the same molecule due no-seed whole-protein-box Vina variance, but route/prep/descriptor validation remained clean. An attempted seeded pocket-centered docking sweep was interrupted/faulted on a large tricyclic MCL-1 comparator and was not used as positive evidence. Evidence files: file:experiments/final_eval_t2/summary.json, file:experiments/final_eval_t2/per_molecule.csv, final artifact /work/targetmol/run/agent/candidate/result.zip.
